BH: B"H / Boruch Hashem / Blessed is He
content:
# B"H

## Boruch Hashem — Blessed is He

From boundless light the vessels receive a measured line;
A clean interface becomes stronger when every boundary is fine.

# Phase Two — Architecture Candidates

A. Page-local CSS only: safest isolation, but repeated patterns can drift.

B. Shared global design system: fastest consistency, but violates the no-global-conflict requirement unless every selector is namespaced.

C. Namespaced feature capsules: each surface imports local tokens, primitives, motion, and page rules beneath a unique root class. This is the preferred foundation.

D. Shadow DOM custom elements: strongest isolation, but migration cost and existing DOM/API coupling may be too high.

E. Inline component styles: isolation is acceptable but maintainability and caching are weaker for this codebase.

Preferred direction: C, with optional D only for self-contained future widgets.

JavaScript direction: small classes with explicit contracts; data-driven state descriptors; shared transport/adapters separated from renderers; event coordination separated from DOM querying; inheritance only for genuine lifecycle families.

Verification target: route-by-route browser evidence at narrow mobile, wide mobile, tablet, and desktop widths; console errors; overflow detection; focus traversal; API failures; reduced motion; touch target sizing; and regression checks for existing user flows.
